name: MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-CXR-JPG (PhysioNet)
what: 377,110 chest radiographs of 227,835 studies, 65,379 patients, Beth Israel Deaconess; frontal and lateral views, the lateral share roughly a third (to confirm from the metadata CSV)
level_truth: none; the thoracic spine T1 to about L1 in a lateral chest film
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; PhysioNet credentialed access (CITI training and the data use agreement, as VinDr-SpineXR needed); the largest source of lateral chest films, hence of thoracic spine laterals, free of charge once credentialed
licence: PhysioNet credentialed health data licence; to confirm on the page
how_to_get: The owner's PhysioNet credentialing (CITI training on file) and the data use agreement on the record page, signed by the owner, the route VinDr-SpineXR took.

Then a recursive wget with the owner's PhysioNet login as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node, as the manifest's vindr_spinexr route does, and sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt on the copy.
An IRB determination before any training reads it, as for VinDr-SpineXR.
